_doc: s148h First step split (DECISIONS_DIGEST 2026-10-20): brief -> [[band (0-based .w5b in the First step), [order number per finding]]]. Not split, because a result there belongs to several orders or the band has no results: psych-medical band 1 ("Other result suggesting a medical cause" and "Normal" read across orders 1, 2, 3 and 5), voices band 0 (both results read across both orders), tca-tox band 1 (three orders, no results). S5 (round 1, display and read MED, acc-D LOW): also left unsplit, because one order would head no result: toxidrome band 1 ("Salicylate level" has no result in the band) and ipv band 0 ("Ask, tactfully, whether she feels safe" heads no result); a pairing needs every order to head at least one result.
